capabilities: Fetch Letterboxd diary viewings as individual notes
Batch import viewing history from Letterboxd's exported data
Create extended film notes using the TMDB API
Customize note templates with the Eta templating engine
extras: The README says the plugin is pending approval in the Obsidian Community directory and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; detailed installation, usage and template documentation lives in separate guides.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull your Letterboxd viewing diary into your vault as notes.

relations.evidence: Fetch viewings each viewing from your Letterboxd diary as individual notes.
Integrate with TMDB API to create additional notes with extended information for each film.

summary: Letterboxd integration that syncs your film diary entries as individual notes, with optional TMDB-enriched film notes.
